title: Von Braun captured in Bavaria under Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: He was captured in Bavaria, where a young Henry Kissinger was actually helping run counterintelligence for the United States. von Braun's record was scrubbed,

plain: In 1945 the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun was captured in Bavaria, in southern Germany, and his record was then "scrubbed", or cleaned up. This happened under Operation Paperclip, the American programme that brought German scientists to the United States after the Second World War. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and adds that a young Henry Kissinger, later one of America's best-known diplomats, was helping to run counterintelligence (the work of catching enemy spies) for the United States in that same area. He tells it to show that the American space effort began by quietly taking in men from Hitler's Germany.
